title: PR pytest-run holds 12 of 20 runner slots for ~40 min each
note: P1 BUILT, HOLD PR #18240 (tier_2_3_needs_approval). On pull_request ONLY, pytest-run runs import-graph-affected tests (scripts/ci/pytest_run_scope.py classify_affected), with a full-suite fallback on: conftest; requirements/pyproject; .github/ or scripts/ci/; guard scripts; config-named or every-test (conftest-eager) modules; fan-in >50%; selector error. Push to main stays full. claude-run-failure-alert now watches pytest-run (push/main only). MEASURED replay (164 main commits, 24h to 2026-10-15T08:30Z; 33 code diffs): 14 affected / 3 data / 16 full; about 756 runner-min/day saved (~0.5 slot). RESIDUAL RISK: auto-merged PR merge commits start no push run, so post-merge full-suite coverage lags to the next non-token push (median 34 min, unbounded if automation pushes stop). State: built, not merged.
